title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00142 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 07:30: Continued drilling 4 ea holes. Worn out one bit each hole. Spent approximately 1,5 hour each hole. Experienced slow progress at the end of fourth hole due to wear on bit.
07:30 - 07:45: Cleaned and cleared th profile.
07:45 - 08:00: R/d th drilling equipment from WH.
08:00 - 09:30: Worked free stop ring and activation ring from th. Observed dirt below stop ring, which possibly prevented activation ring to stroke up to fully released position. Removed stop ring and activation ring. Th lock ring collapsed out of locking grooves. Removed lock ring. Meanwhile performed TBT for n/u BOP
09:30 - 09:45: Removed hatch. Pulled master bushing.
09:45 - 10:30: Lowered HP riser joint from drill floor to WH. M/u connector on WH installed hatch around riser.
10:30 - 10:45: Installed scaffolding around riser in moonpool.
10:45 - 12:15: Skidded BOP over well center. Landed onto riser joint. M/u BOP connector on riser joint.
12:15 - 12:30: Installed slipjoint. Installed masterbushing.
12:30 - 14:30: Installed tension cylinders to BOP. Meanwhile prepared diverter.
14:30 - 15:00: M/u bolts on slipjoint.
15:00 - 16:00: Insalled diverter.
16:00 - 16:30: Load shifted weight from BOP carrier to tension system. Pressurized diverter system, koomey unit and overshot.
16:30 - 16:45: Filled BOP with SW
16:45 - 17:15: Performed BOP connector test to 20/235 bar for 5/10min. Meanwhile r/u spooling unit for control lines.
17:15 - 17:30: M/u BPV RT
17:30 - 17:45: RIH w/ BPV RT on 3 1/2" DP
17:45 - 18:00: Retrieved BPV dart.
18:00 - 18:15: RIH with BPV RT on 3 1/2" DP retrieved BPV plug
18:15 - 18:30: R/u handling equipment for 5 1/2" meanwhile performed TBT for running spear BHA.
18:30 - 19:45: Reconfigured spear BHA in order to handle th at surface. B/o and l/o double 5 1/2" DP.
19:45 - 20:00: RIH w/spear BHA to 25m. Engaged spear
20:00 - 20:15: Pulled tubing free, 10 ton OP.
20:15 - 20:30: POOH w/ tubng on spear. L/d 1 single 5 1/2" DP to space out on surface).
